data.message: I propose 10 tons each this month: 25×10=250 caught, leaving 250, so stock returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome. Repeating this earns each of us $10,000 every month without collapse risk. I intend to request 10 if this plan gains broad support. If stock later falls below 500, we should scale catches down to leave at least half the stock and never less than 25 tons.
